text:
adrian.sales: Heads up 10AM call with HealthCorp. They want a 2-week POC. Requirements: hosted API for most traffic, Private/VPC for PHI routes, scoped ephemeral keys, console SSO for 4 reviewers, audit log extracts for their auditors, option to stream to Splunk HEC or S3, and confirmation we can integrate with their AWS KMS. Also asked for a Dedicated trial cost estimate. Can we deliver kickoff next Monday?

lina.se: We can support that pattern. Recommend start hosted with IP-restricted ephemeral keys, then cut over sensitive flows to Private/VPC. For SSO we need IdP metadata; we can create 4 SAML user mappings for the POC.

ben.sre: Audit log format: NDJSON one-line per request. Fields: request_id, ts, tenant_id (if provided), model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, route, status, latency_ms, error_code (nullable). Hosted retention default 30d. Exports to S3 unlimited per their bucket lifecycle.

priya.security: KMS: hosted uses our managed KMS. Private supports customer-managed KMS (AWS KMS) but requires key policy updates and a short security review (2-3 business days). If HealthCorp requires special key wrapping/HSM attestations, escalate. Also we need NDA before sharing SOC2 artifacts.

sam.platform: Dedicated trial: we can offer a short reserved pool (1-week min) for evaluation. Pricing needs customer's expected throughput to size GPUs. @adrian.sales capture RPS and token estimates.

lina.se: For Splunk hookup we accept HEC over TLS (token + IP allowlist) or S3 with a write role. Please ask them which and provide creds.

adrian.sales: They prefer HEC. I'll ask for endpoint, token, and allowed egress IPs. Also sending their security questionnaire now.

ops-bot: Created temp export path s3://redwood-poc-exports/healthcorp/1913000123/ (auto-delete 14d)

ben.sre: Example redacted line:
```
{"request_id":"req_02AaZ","timestamp":"2026-03-19T09:12:05Z","tenant_id":"health-redacted","model":"gptx-3.8","prompt_tokens":40,"completion_tokens":96,"total_tokens":136,"route":"hosted-eu-west-1","status":"ok","latency_ms":110}
```

devex: I'll prep a short runbook (ephemeral key creation, Splunk sample query, dashboard layout). Posting link to team runbook shortly.

priya.security: Please secure an NDA before we hand over sample logs or SOC2. Once NDA is in place I will attach a redacted audit export and a controls mapping document.

adrian.sales: Uploaded questionnaire here: https://files.redwood/healthcorp/sq-1913000123.pdf. Pushing NDA now.

lina.se: I'll file infra request for ephemeral key + IP allowlist and HEC stream. Assigning to @ben.sre for HEC setup and @devex for runbook. Ben, I need the HEC token or bucket role to start; estimate 4-6 hours after creds.

ben.sre: Acknowledged. Will stand up HEC forwarder and validate TLS cert. If they want custom cert chain validation, send cert bundle.

adrian.sales: Timeline note: they want console access in POC for auditors next Wed. If NDA and IdP metadata land today we can meet that.

priya.security: I'll review the questionnaire and flag anything blocking. For CMK requests start the KMS onboarding request now so it's not a blocker.

lina.se: Summary checklist I'll post in this thread once I validate the SFQ items. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
